# Setupr Ecosystem

> Setupr is a technology ecosystem building autonomous AI tools, custom web applications, API integrations, and global business setup. We operate across three core divisions: Setupr Lab (products & R&D), Setupr Services (bespoke digital solutions), and Setupr Cloud (SaaS marketplace).

## Core Divisions

### 1. Setupr Lab (Products & R&D)
Setupr Lab is our software innovation hub creating open-source developer tooling, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and autonomous browser extensions:
- **Blew by Setupr (`blew-by-setupr`)**: The zero-dashboard social media autopilot for AI agents. Allows AI agents in Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity, or ChatGPT to publish and syndicate high-engagement content straight to X (Twitter) and LinkedIn via MCP and browser session authentication.
- **Setupr MCP Hub**: Model Context Protocol connectors linking autonomous agents directly to real-world business infrastructure.
- **Founder Toolkits**: CLI utilities and automated operational blueprints for technical founders.
- GitHub: https://github.com/amireality/blew-by-setupr

### 2. Setupr Services (Solutions & Infrastructure)
Full-stack engineering and business infrastructure:
- **Custom Websites & Web Apps**: High-performance React and Next.js applications, conversion-optimized landing pages, and web apps.
- **Feature Integrations**: WhatsApp Business API, Stripe / Razorpay payment gateways, CRM synchronization, and authentication.
- **AI Automations**: Custom AI agents, autonomous customer support bots, and internal workflow automations.
- **Business Formation**: End-to-end legal entity formation (Private Limited, LLP, LLC, Sole Proprietorship), tax registration, and banking readiness.

### 3. Setupr Cloud & Store
Authorized SaaS subscriptions and cloud provisioning:
- Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, Zoho, Adobe.
- Direct enterprise provisioning with unified invoicing and dedicated technical support.
